catalogue_requests.reason: no catalogue class turns off the pump and gripper of a liquid handler without claiming a motion stop: cap.actuation.pump.v1 requires a flow rate and a direction the on/off uArm pump does not have, and cap.motion.stop.v1 would claim a motion halt the upstream API does not offer; the extension is also the SAFE-045 safe-state action
catalogue_requests.summary: Turn the pump and the gripper off; the declared safe state.

notes:
Passed on the fake backend only by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/labs/idc-milab__openlh --backend fake (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). The package is model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json authored_by is the model deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run wP-011, and reviewed_by stays null; the R2 hardware backend is refused by the loader until a human signs reviewed_by; no hardware was attached and no hardware run is claimed.

DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card proposes SerialDriver (family serial). The upstream wrapper assembles every wire line from a command letter and run-time values: set_position builds G0 plus X/Y/Z/F (pyuf/uf/wrapper/swift_api.py:220-243) and set_servo_angle builds G202 plus N/V (pyuf/uf/wrapper/swift_api.py:331-333), so a SerialDriver command table cannot reproduce the bytes. This package is a direct Driver over pyuf.uf.wrapper.swift_with_ultrasonic:SwiftWithUltrasonic with native.py for the hardware backend.

RISK: the card risk_floor is R1, but the device is a robot arm and a liquid handler; MHS/spec/04-safety.md:68 puts pipetting into a plate at R2 and the task instructions put a robot arm at R2, so risk is R2.

SAFETY: no text file of the clone documents an independent hardware e-stop or power switch (the developer guide exists only as pyuf/uArm-Swift-Pro-Develper-Guide-171013.pdf and was not cited because no page was read), so estop_physical_ref is not set. The safe-state action x-cap.idc-milab.tool_off.v1 turns the pump and gripper off and satisfies SAFE-045; @estop does the same. The upstream SwiftAPI has no motion stop, abort or halt method (the whole class is pyuf/uf/wrapper/swift_api.py:27-725); close_conn only closes the serial port (117-119) and reset moves to the default position (121-137). A move already sent to the firmware may therefore complete; safe_state, facts.md and the reference say so.

COVERAGE (fake only): reads position x/y/z, polar rotation/stretch/height, the four servo angles, ultrasonic distance, limit switch, is_moving, and the last pump/gripper commands (the clone has no query for those two); writes the four servo angles bounded 0-180 deg (upstream_code pyuf/uf/wrapper/swift_api.py:321), pump on/off and gripper closed/open; action cap.motion.cartesian_pose.v1 for an absolute X/Y/Z move with position.x/y/z as Limit.operator_required because the clone states no workspace and set_position returns ok even out of range (pyuf/uf/wrapper/swift_api.py:246); extension safe-state action. site-limits.example.json supplies example-only Cartesian bounds; without an operator overlay every Cartesian move is refused MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET. fixtures/conformance.json supplies in-range and out-of-range Cartesian inputs because the class example 300/0/250 lies outside the example overlay.

NOT BOUND: cap.manipulation.grasp.v1 (the uArm gripper is on/off with no force or width, so the class would misstate the inputs; gripper_closed is a writable boolean), cap.actuation.pump.v1 (on/off pump, no flow rate or direction), cap.motion.joint_position.v1 (a radian joint vector would re-encode the degree setters; per-servo writes keep the sourced 0-180 bound), cap.sensing.read.v1 (it binds sensor/imu/force_torque, not robot.arm). get_analog, get_digital, ROM access, buzzer, report callbacks, reset and raw serial are not exposed.

NOT COVERED: the ultrasonic sensor is read at the constructor default port D8 only; no calibration, firmware, raw serial transport or reporting callback is bound. The fake is an in-memory recording-style stand-in because the clone has no simulator, mock or recorded transcript (its tests are hardware scripts); every initial value in fake.py is test data marked placeholder, not a fact. No G4 warnings were reported; all nine gates passed with no findings. The example site-limits numbers are operator examples, not device facts.
